# VOOO LABS — Digital Systems & Software Engineering Studio

> Independent web and software engineering studio founded by Vrushabh Shinde in Maharashtra, India. We engineer custom business websites, progressive web applications, internal business software, and technical Google/AI search architecture with 100% client source code ownership.

For our complete, detailed knowledge base and operational policies, see: https://vooolabs.in/llms-full.txt

## Studio Overview
- **Legal Entity:** VOOO LABS
- **Founder & Systems Architect:** Vrushabh Shinde
- **Website:** https://vooolabs.in
- **Direct Email:** hello@vooolabs.in
- **Legal & Compliance Email:** legal@vooolabs.in
- **Billing & Support Email:** billing@vooolabs.in
- **Operational Hubs:** Pune, Nashik, Satara, Kolhapur (Maharashtra, India)
- **Primary Delivery Guarantee:** 100% Client Source Code Ownership (Private GitHub Repository Handover) with Zero Recurring Vendor Lock-In.
- **Infrastructure Model:** Domains and cloud hosting are registered directly in the client's name and billed at actual provider rates with zero middleman markup.

## Core Engineering Systems

### 1. Business Websites
- URL: https://vooolabs.in/services/websites
- High-speed, responsive corporate and product websites built on React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
- Sub-second Time-To-First-Byte (TTFB), dynamic schema generation, and direct WhatsApp customer conversion funnels.

### 2. Custom Web Apps & Portals
- URL: https://vooolabs.in/services/web-apps
- Progressive web apps, customer portals, multi-tenant SaaS dashboards, and booking engines running in any modern browser.
- Bypasses 30% app store commission fees, zero app-store download friction, cross-platform on iOS, Android, and desktop.

### 3. Custom Business Software
- URL: https://vooolabs.in/services/business-software
- Tailored internal operating systems, inventory trackers, ERP/CRM modules, and automated invoicing engines designed to replace messy spreadsheets.
- Strict Row-Level Security (RLS) on PostgreSQL, automated backups, and real-time operational auditing.

### 4. Google SEO, AI Search & Ads
- URL: https://vooolabs.in/seo-ai
- Four distinct discovery channels:
  - Technical Google SEO: https://vooolabs.in/seo-ai/google-seo (Semantic hierarchy, fast indexing)
  - ChatGPT & AI Search Readiness (AEO): https://vooolabs.in/seo-ai/ai-search (JSON-LD @graph, llms.txt)
  - Google Maps Local Authority: https://vooolabs.in/seo-ai/google-maps (Local pack, 1-tap WhatsApp reviews)
  - Targeted Google Search Ads: https://vooolabs.in/seo-ai/google-ads (Single-intent landing pages, WhatsApp attribution)

## Commercial Model & Milestones (40% — 30% — 30%)
- **Milestone 01 (40% Advance):** Kickoff & Interactive Live Frontend Prototype deployed on private staging URL for early UI/UX approval.
- **Milestone 02 (30% Mid-Build):** Backend architecture, database schemas, and third-party API wiring upon frontend approval.
- **Milestone 03 (30% Final Settlement):** Final QA verification, production deployment, and private GitHub repository transfer.
- **Revision Policy:** 2 structured frontend revision rounds included.
- **Sign-Off Rule:** 5-business-day review window per milestone.
